The salary for a **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** in India typically ranges from **₹8 LPA to ₹90+ LPA** , depending on experience, location, and whether the employer is a traditional IT service provider, an AI startup, or a global tech company.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1_ovX6yXfZsAyFs63dgtL6pyyJe0p589V2RRj-V777IHoUs4k82A83n0tdHOIObEpROHjGvVfG_V4cSl-e7uiNILiGIjSR2eItoYKSubFTMp2FHQ3prZqCQAf0FAPH-T8FZm-s9TEPjwyhO_Rxu5zOiOIssy6OdDqNmWUmDGOm00jQXa)

#### Salary Breakdown by Experience

- **Beginner / Entry-Level (0–2 years):** ₹8 – ₹28 LPA *(lower end at large IT/service firms; higher end at specialized AI startups)* 
- **Mid-Level (3–6 years):** ₹28 – ₹55 LPA *(leading full projects and client communication)* 
- **Senior / Lead (7+ years):** ₹55 – ₹90+ LPA *(system design, owning major client relationships and high-value deals)* [[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1_ovX6yXfZsAyFs63dgtL6pyyJe0p589V2RRj-V777IHoUs4k82A83n0tdHOIObEpROHjGvVfG_V4cSl-e7uiNILiGIjSR2eItoYKSubFTMp2FHQ3prZqCQAf0FAPH-T8FZm-s9TEPjwyhO_Rxu5zOiOIssy6OdDqNmWUmDGOm00jQXa)

#### Compensation by City & Hub

- **Top Paying Cities:** Bengaluru, Hyderabad , and Gurugram house the highest concentration of high-paying FDE roles and global tech footprints.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1_ovX6yXfZsAyFs63dgtL6pyyJe0p589V2RRj-V777IHoUs4k82A83n0tdHOIObEpROHjGvVfG_V4cSl-e7uiNILiGIjSR2eItoYKSubFTMp2FHQ3prZqCQAf0FAPH-T8FZm-s9TEPjwyhO_Rxu5zOiOIssy6OdDqNmWUmDGOm00jQXa)
- **Recent Market Samples (Glassdoor/AmbitionBox Data):** 
	- Mid-to-senior ranges in hubs like Bengaluru and Hyderabad vary widely from ₹20 LPA to over ₹60 LPA depending on company backing.
	- Standard or service-based roles span lower baselines around ₹8 – ₹15 LPA.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF17wD7zBFvq_Soxo0B1RS0MmzxEJOY_dnfYpzL5gTNqeyOeRQWfciBJJS0TJzxqoZfDQa9JjkCwhyRygxX3XSHeuLsmsGWsGg8PTNrFxY3i-Nl2Ta31rTz1G_wUkTZEwr6ubbZBqKfBj2h1WSFseDvBCYmqXVI3657nFtw_XHgc-TjrA4AnbioHlYdaFkkg0IuJ2hGIzNjDxe4wa7EalPKGWNENa04yA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1_ovX6yXfZsAyFs63dgtL6pyyJe0p589V2RRj-V777IHoUs4k82A83n0tdHOIObEpROHjGvVfG_V4cSl-e7uiNILiGIjSR2eItoYKSubFTMp2FHQ3prZqCQAf0FAPH-T8FZm-s9TEPjwyhO_Rxu5zOiOIssy6OdDqNmWUmDGOm00jQXa)
